title: Senior Cloud Software Engineer
description: Provided part-time reach-back support for the Radio Frequency Interference Monitoring System (RFIMS) while working at AWS, spanning completion of the development contract valued at up to $148.4 million and transition to a follow-on Operations, Maintenance and Sustainment contract valued at up to $49.0 million. Helped sustain security authorization, strengthen cloud-security practices, and keep customer delivery activities on schedule.
highlights: Evaluated each deployed system against applicable NIST controls and supported the evidence and remediation work required to maintain Authorization to Operate.
Trained internal team members on AWS and cloud tooling that streamlined investigation and resolution of security findings.
Created internal technical and operational documentation that formed a reusable knowledge repository and accelerated onboarding for future team members.
Supported customer meetings, communicated technical and security progress, and helped keep site-delivery schedules on track.
